item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong being replaced by a humid maritime airstream gradually, there will be fog over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be warm during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China next Tuesday. Temperatures will fall over the region. Under the influence of the associated dry continental airstream, it will be cool in the morning and the weather will be fine over Guangdong midweek next week.
